reviewer_notes: The paper fits two model families (MLR and MLP ANN) to three distinct dependent variables (electrical energy, steam, cooling water consumption), yielding six models (M1–M6). ANN metrics recorded are the reported optimum configuration (LM learning algorithm, 1 and 1 hidden-layer neurons). Reported R2 and MAPE are treated as out-of-sample validation metrics because the paper computes them by comparing predicted outputs on the test set (181 days) with actual data; no separate in-sample fit is reported. Cooling water consumption (m3/day) is not strictly an energy vector; coded as 'other' since the paper treats it as a modelled energy-management output. The full dataset is 2,012 days; 118 noisy days were removed and the remainder split 1,713 train / 181 test. CUSUM energy-saving results (Table VI) were computed only for the selected MLR models, so energy_result is not reported for the ANN models. Estimation method for MLR is not explicitly stated beyond use of the MATLAB mvregress toolbox.
